data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use Google's ML Kit Selfie Segmentation API.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that uses Google's ML Kit Selfie Segmentation API to separate the background from users within a scene. It passes calls via platform channels to native iOS and Android APIs, returning segmentation masks with confidence scores.
use_when: You need to separate users from backgrounds in selfies or video streams on Android and iOS.
You want to leverage on-device machine learning for real-time segmentation.
avoid_when: You are targeting web or desktop platforms.
You require custom model training or custom architecture beyond Google's pre-built selfie segmentation.
strengths: Leverages optimized native Google ML Kit APIs.
Supports both single images and stream modes with configurable options.
weaknesses: Mobile only (Android and iOS); web or other platforms are not supported.
Running segmentation inference on Apple Silicon iOS simulators requires physical hardware or specific setup limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum iOS deployment target to 15.0, configuring Xcode linker flags (-ObjC and -all_load), downloading ML Kit resource bundles manually via Swift Package Manager setup, and configuring Android minimum SDK to 21 with compileSdk 36.

alternatives.name: google_ml_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: It includes selfie segmentation along with many other ML Kit vision and natural language features under a single package.
